ONE KNOB vs the iter-10 base (K=10, epochs=10, lambda=1.0, train_n=400): train_n 400->800 (2x, was 3x). HYPOTHESIS: more training phantoms give the 20 step/lambda scalars a less-noisy gradient of the optimal per-iter TV schedule so hr rises above 0.1495. FALSIFIER: hr ~0.15 -> the 20-scalar schedule is data-saturated at train_n=400 and ~0.15 is the config-only ceiling. BUDGET: train_n=800 epochs=10 ~ 2x the iter-10 train (~750s) minus fixed val/load -> est ~1050-1150s, under 1200s wall.
